    - `python -m scripts.raisa_provider_free_unmounted_durability_inert_ddl_rehearsal check`: PASSED (`check: ok`)
    - `git diff --check 5237a083..5a9a7ae9`: PASSED (Clean diff, no whitespace warnings)
